review.search_scope: Current research branch review packet, candidate paths semantic-core-independent-review.json, semantic-core-review-result.json, core-diagnostics-approval.json, core-diagnostics-precommit.json returned 404; repository issue search H38N8A and SEMANTIC CORE empty. review.required_artifact: Separate reviewer attestation with reviewer identity/independence statement, source packet blob, blinded label assignments and disagreement resolution, construction equivalence decisions, all eight role/polarity cells per retained frame, unsupported relation labels, exact reviewed fixture text hashes. Reviewer must not see proposed labels or model outputs during blind labeling. Author cannot self-certify independence.

approval.required_artifact: Owner approval binding revised fixture manifest hash, review artifact, pinned G2 and executor, single read-only GitHub Actions diagnostic run and CPU/time bounds. Does not authorize training.

design.objective: Finite fixture-level representation and G2 behavior checks; not cross-family generalization, not statistical domain admission, not gain exam.
design.unit: Up to five reviewed frame variants each one complete 2x2x2 block; group equivalence recorded; variants not independent families. Two independently verified distinct unsupported relation fixtures per retained block only if semantically justified. No filler, no training/eval split, no new probe fit. No minimum diversity claim. If known cells incomplete retain separate partial diagnostic records only if preapproved; no four-pair aggregation for incomplete blocks. No post-score relabeling.
design.review_sequence: Freeze proposed unlabeled strings for reviewer in isolated review manifest after approval of review process; independently label and resolve without scores, freeze final reviewed fixture manifest with canonical SHA256 and exact row IDs, then require owner approval before run. Do not treat same-author proposal as sealed exam.
design.historical_overlap: Compare exact normalized strings and hashes against 54 attempted, 27 historical exam, approved forbidden hashes and retained 36 subset; flag near duplicates and exposure. Historical/exposed fixtures may be retained only as labeled regression controls separate from new reviewed diagnostics; no claims of unseen generalization. Keep conflicting feature vectors rather than dedup them.
design.execution: Proposed single GitHub Actions CPU job <=5 minutes, pinned Python version/commit and source/state blob verification before inference, local pure CPU; permissions contents:read, no write token, no network during inference if feasible and explicitly recorded, no training, no state commit, no production. Result artifact and immutable run/commit evidence; manual archive of report in research branch after review. No job actually created or launched.

metrics.feature: Call pinned features() and rows() on projected text/y input, verify exact normalized active-index list; separately check original state check() and weights digest() against pins. All exact conflicting known-class groups and per-axis contexts; collision counts and deterministic finite-sample upper bound with exact equality only. Report Jaccard/Hamming as descriptive; do not confuse near collision with exact. HOLD balanced bound per v3 weighted formula only when both strata exist.
metrics.G2: Use pinned probabilities() and predict() for actual output; compute logits with exact same normalized active bins and weights, verify probability parity and first-index tie behavior. Known-only forced argmax, raw nine-class argmax, operational prediction. Counts for correct/incorrect/abstain, coverage, known accuracy, selective accuracy, correct HOLD/false HOLD/unknown acceptance. Distinguish class16 argmax from known argmax with p<.65; no retuning. Confusions by class and axis; show denominators and undefined rates.
metrics.minimal_pairs: G2 secondary score s=logsumexp(axis1 known logits)-logsumexp(axis0 known logits), d=s(gold1)-s(gold0), tie tolerance 1e-12. Four pairs per complete block per axis, keep raw d and signs, report |d|<.01 fraction, median and quantiles, both-correct/reversed/constant, operational abstentions separately. Family sign descriptive only; no sign-test p-value, no Holm, no confidence or confirmatory claims for current fixtures. Reversed orientation audit class map, row labels, pair order, feature parity before weights interpretation.
metrics.safety: No score() mutation, no fit(), no cycle(), no production write, no G3, no new training budget. Report failures without automatic retry.
